sloka: एवं नानाप्रहरणैर्यमेनामित्रकर्षिणा ।सप्तरात्रं कृतः सङ्ख्ये विसञ्ज्ञो विमुखो रिपुः ।। ७.२२.१६ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ nānāpraharaṇairyamenāmitrakarṣiṇā ।saptarātraṁ kṛtaḥ saṅkhye visañjño vimukho ripuḥ ।। 7.22.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, as powerful arrows struck his broad chest, that demon, afflicted by the shafts, was unable to retaliate.
